title: Edward Teller on the UFO legacy program

tellings.quote: I vaguely remember some people suggesting that Edward Teller maybe was one of the maybe one of the physicists who if he if there is this legacy program he would be one

plain: The physicist Edward Teller has been put forward as one of the scientists who might have worked in a "legacy program," a claimed secret effort to study recovered non-human craft, if such a program exists. The physicist Maaneli Derakhshani tells Michels that he vaguely remembers some people suggesting this, and he says only that Teller "would be one."
